artifacts.name: database-schema
artifacts.description: PostgreSQL DDL — all tables, indexes, triggers, constraints, views (v_org_display_names, v_person_display_names), and seed data. Source of truth for the data model.

artifacts.name: agent-guidelines
artifacts.description: Agent guidelines — project overview, development methodology (TDD), environment/tooling, project layout, admin/public API conventions, DB conventions, and the index of the reference-docs tree.

artifacts.name: reference-docs
artifacts.description: The whole reference-doc tree, indexed recursively. Domain and data: schema tables and indexes, validity windows, observation semantics, person/org names. Public API: auth, scopes, pagination, conditional requests, the change feed, and per-resource endpoint contracts. Admin dashboard: auth and archive model, HTMX partial patterns, UI components, forms, merge flows, visual style, accessibility. Operating it: everyday commands, test tiers, runbooks, recurring integrity audits, DB triage and migration. Also holds docs/plans — historical feature design docs and implementation plans.
